        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_source_pip_closure_receipt_hash value = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_hash }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_b2_pip_outcome_code = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_outcome_quality value = 1 } # graduated: pass
        }
        else = {

        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_awaiting_pip value = 0 }
        zg361_workforce_probation_fact_publish_canonical_effect = yes
    }
    else = {

    }
